description: This file defines a custom exception class named ConnectionLimitAutoConfigException used to indicate failure in auto-configuration of connection limits within the Eclipse Hono service, specifically in the limiting module.

classes.name: ConnectionLimitAutoConfigException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending RuntimeException, used to signal auto-configuration failures related to connection limiting.

methods.name: ConnectionLimitAutoConfigException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a provided message.
